 Vs.
 Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.
 Mr. Bikash Singha,
 Mr. Abdul Habib
 .... for the appellants/claimants.

entities.text: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
Mr.Hirak Barman
 ...for the respondent No. 1/Insurance Co.

1. Learned advocate for the appellants/claimants and learned advocate for the respondent No. 1
Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company are present.
2. Heard the learned advocates for the parties.

3. The appellant before this Court was a claimant in a claim case under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 and is aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 20th February, 2025 passed by learned Additional District Judge, F.T.C. 1st Court, Jalpaiguri in MAC Case No. 26 of 2019.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, F.T.C. 1st Court, Jalpaiguri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Upon hearing the learned advocates and considering the evidences the learned Trial Judge was pleased to dispose of the claim case by observing and directing as follows:
"Hence, it is, ORDERED

That the instant case filed u/s 166 of Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 is allowed on contest as against the O.P. No. 2/Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Comp. Ltd. and ex-parte against the O.P. No.-1/owner.

entities.text: O.P. No. 2/Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Comp. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The petitioners/claimants Deya Rani Deb Yadav, Raja Yadav and Reena Yadav being the legal heirs and representative of the deceased/victim Ashok Yadav do get an award of Rs.40,56,580/ (Forty Lakh fifty six thousand five hundred and eighty only)
in equal shares subject to payment of DCF if any.

Petitioner No.1 being the legal guardian of the minor petitioner no.2 and 3 namely Raja Yadav and Rina Yadav is given the liberty to receive the cheques for and on behalf of the minors and she is also Smt. Deya Rani Dev Yadav & Ors vs Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. ...

fixed deposit scheme before any nationalized bank or post office with a liberty to withdraw the interest accrued thereon and to spend the same for the purpose of welfare benefit of the minors till the minors attains majority.

The Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Com. Ltd. is directed to pay the awarded amount to the above mentioned petitioners/claimants within two months from the date of passing of this order, failing which company will liable to pay the award with interest @ 6% p.a. from date of filing of this case.

entities.text: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Com. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioners/claimants will be at liberty to put this award in execution in accordance with law if the judgment debtor fails to satisfy the award within the stipulated period.

However, considering the entire aspects this Tribunal passes no order as to cost".
5.
Learned advocates for the appellants submit that the learned Trial Court erred while not granting interest from the date of filing till date of realization.

Learned advocate for the appellants relies upon the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Janabai and Others Versus I.C.I.C.I.
Lombord Insurance Company Ltd reported in 2022 (3) T.A.C. 705 (S.C.).
6.

entities.text:
Janabai and Others Versus I.C.I.C.I.
Lombord Insurance Company Ltd reported in 2022 (3) T.A.C. 705 (S.C.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Upon hearing the learned advocates and upon considering the facts of the case, this Court is of the view that Section 171 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 which empowers the Court to award interest should be considered.

As per Section 171 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 where any claim tribunal allows the claim for compensation made under this Act such tribunal may direct that in addition to the amount of compensation simple interest shall also be paid at such rate and from such date not earlier the date of making the claim as it may specify in this behalf.
Although the discretion is provided in the said Section but it is held in different judicial pronouncement that grant of interest is the law and refusal is the exception.
7. In the instant case, no special reason is assigned by the learned Trial Judge as to why the interest is not awarded from the date of filing of the claim case till date of payment.
8. Thus, the judgement and award passed by the learned Trial Judge should be modified.
9. Hence this appeal is disposed of.

10. The judgement and award dated 20th February, 2025 passed by learned Additional District Judge, F.T.C. 1st Court, Jalpaiguri in MAC Case No. 26 of 2019 stands modified to the extent that the appellant is entitled to interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim case till the date of deposit made by the Insurance Company.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, F.T.C. 1st Court, Jalpaiguri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 11. The payment with regard to the interest in terms of this order shall be made by the Insurance Company within five weeks from the date of communication of this order.
12. The deposit in this matter shall be made before the Registrar Circuit Bench, Jalpaiguri, High Court, Calcutta within the said period.
